subject: Stratagem reference deployment — conformance review and test plan
messages:
From: Tim Hendrix <tim.hendrix@stratagemconsult.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: integration@stratagemconsult.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reference deployment and conformance checks for managed services

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for yesterday's briefing — Stragtagem is excited to move forward with a joint reference deployment that demonstrates our managed-services integration with Redwood. Attached is our current reference architecture (stratagem-reference-architecture-v2.pdf) and a short KPI matrix (stratagem-kpi-scenarios.xlsx).

We need to validate the following before we list the joint solution on our marketplace:
- Functional parity for chat & embeddings across expected request patterns
- Token-level latency targets at 99th percentile under the load profile in the KPI sheet
- Validation of private deployment networking (VPC peering & egress controls)

Can your team propose a conformance test plan and estimate engineering time for the validation pass? Ideally we'd do a joint smoke run the week of May 24.

Thanks,
Tim Hendrix
VP, Strategic Partnerships
Stratagem Consulting
Attachments: stratagem-reference-architecture-v2.pdf (PDF), stratagem-kpi-scenarios.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Hendrix <tim.hendrix@stratagemconsult.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reference deployment and conformance checks for managed services

Tim —

Appreciate the materials and the clear acceptance points. We'll own the Redwood-side conformance pass and propose the detailed test plan by EOD Monday (May 17). High level next steps from our side:

1) Internal scoping & ownership: Marissa will own test orchestration, Karthik will own runtime/config validation.
2) Test plan deliverable: pass/fail criteria, tooling (wrk, custom token trace), and runbook for private deployment checks.
3) Data & infra: we need the expected token distribution (sample traces) and a non-prod VPC account for network validation.

A couple of quick asks to help size effort:
- Can you share a sample 24-hour request trace (anonymized) or a representative RPS profile?
- Will you need Redwood to run quantized model variants for cost parity testing?

I'm looping in Marissa and Karthik to draft the plan and estimated engineering days.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reference deployment and conformance checks for managed services

Sergio / Karthik —

Draft of the conformance test plan (summary):
- Phase A (smoke): verify endpoint parity and basic routing (2 engineer-days)
- Phase B (load & latency): 1-hour 3x peak run + 4-hour soak at 0.5x peak to capture KV cache behavior (4 engineer-days)
- Phase C (security & networking): VPC peering validation, egress control audit, KMS key verification (2 engineer-days)
- Phase D (acceptance): joint review with Stragtagem, runbook handoff, checklist sign-off (1 engineer-day)

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- 99th-percentile token latency <= 380ms for common chat prompt sizes (as defined in KPI sheet)
- Embedding dimensional parity and error-rate < 0.2% vs their baseline
- Private deploy: no unexpected open egress ports; all logs show KMS-encrypted key IDs

Dependencies: sample request traces (Tim), non-prod VPC + cross-account role, and confirmation on whether we should include int8 quant variants.

I'll prepare a short runbook and attach a Redwood conformance-checklist.pdf by Monday. Laura — can you confirm availability of the dedicated test pool for the week of May 24?

Marissa Cole
Partner Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: (planned) redwood-conformance-checklist.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reference deployment and conformance checks for managed services

Quick technical notes for the plan:
- For the load runs we'll provision two c4.large-gpu workers in the dedicated test pool (NVIDIA A10 equivalent) and enable mixed-batch mode. That should reproduce production-like tokenization and KV cache behavior.
- If Stragtagem wants cost parity tests, we'll run the same workload with an int8 quantized variant (we need their sign-off; quantization may change latency profile slightly).
- Network: we'll require a transient peering connection and a route table with explicit mask for the test window. Provide the peer ASN and the subnet ranges.

Attachments: suggested-test-matrix.csv (basic payloads & RPS targets)

Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Hendrix <tim.hendrix@stratagemconsult.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reference deployment and conformance checks for managed services

Tim — thanks for the architecture and KPIs. We reviewed internally and agree with the proposed acceptance criteria. Proposed timeline:

- Monday (May 17): Redwood delivers full conformance test plan + runbook
- Week of May 24: joint smoke + load runs (we propose Wed May 26 at 09:00 PT for the first smoke run)
- Week of May 31: security/network walkthrough and final sign-off

Actions for Stragtagem: please share an anonymized 24-hour request trace and the non-prod VPC details (peer ASN, cidr ranges, cross-account role).

We will include the int8 quant test as an optional toggle — let us know whether you want cost-parity numbers. I'll send a calendar invite for the May 26 smoke run once we get the VPC details.

Best —
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-test-inventory.csv (CSV stub)
body_snippet: Confirming scope and schedule for reference deployment conformance tests; internal owners and acceptance criteria attached.
